name: Disable Shared Experiences
description: Disables Windows Shared Experiences to stop apps from syncing activities across nearby devices, reducing background integration for gaming PCs.

description_i18n.en: Disables Windows Shared Experiences to stop apps from syncing activities across nearby devices, reducing background integration for gaming PCs.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert Windows-Shared-Erlebnisse und verhindert die Synchronisierung von App-Aktivitäten zwischen Geräten. Reduziert Hintergrundintegration für Gaming-PCs.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive les expériences partagées de Windows pour empêcher la synchronisation des activités entre appareils, réduisant l'intégration en arrière-plan.

warnings.title: Cross-Device Features Disabled
warnings.message: Phone-to-PC handoff and nearby device sharing features will stop working on this PC. Windows background integration for these services is reduced

warnings.title: Registry change
warnings.message: Persistent Windows settings may change until the tweak is restored

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Sets the registry value EnableCdp to 0 under HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System This disables Connected Devices Platform / cross-device shared experiences by policy
